aarch64_openmp_alias_review.method: Read-only Dockerfile review and SHA256 of the exact bundled shared-library member in the existing locally verified Torch wheel; no new package, version, wheel, or OS library introduced.
aarch64_openmp_alias_review.scope: Alias creation is limited to CPU_ARCH=aarch64; the fixed runtime search directory is not writable by the application user. Torch x86_64 already bundles the standard SONAME.
aarch64_openmp_alias_review.evidence_boundary: This source review does not claim successful immutable-image imports, model execution, or owner acceptance on a physical MacBook; those require separate observed evidence.
